# Mobile semantic-reference regression fixture

This is a minimal, sanitised regression fixture derived from the separately retained Desktop-authored
`desktop-mobile-layout-evidence` project. It is not claimed to be untouched Desktop output.

`mobile-title/mobile.json` retains the Desktop-observed mobile-only dynamic title expression for
`MobileEvidence[Mobile Only Title]`. `position-only/mobile.json` is the negative control: it contains
only mobile presentation coordinates. The ordinary visual metadata does not name `Mobile Only Title`.
`Unused Measure Control` is not referenced anywhere in the report.
